title: Direct-Booking Courtesy on Room Reservations No-Show Charges
content:
## Direct-booking terms

On a no-show charge on a Room Reservations reservation, a reservation booked directly with Ashbury, through the brand website, the mobile app, the call center or the hotel itself, that carries an active Ashbury Rewards membership has the member direct-booking courtesy of 3% taken off; one booked directly without an active membership has the guest direct-booking courtesy of 1% taken off; a reservation booked through any other channel has no direct-booking courtesy (0%).

The booking channel is the one on the reservation record. The membership is the Ashbury Rewards membership attached to the reservation, and only the status active counts as an active membership; a reservation with no membership attached, or with a suspended or closed one, is booked without an active membership.

| Booking channel | Active Ashbury Rewards membership attached | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| Brand website, mobile app, call center or property direct | Yes | 3% |
| Brand website, mobile app, call center or property direct | No | 1% |
| Online travel agency, travel agency through a global distribution system, or group rooming list | either | none |

The courtesy takes its share off the no-show charge as it stands at that point, before the charge is rounded.

**Illustration (hypothetical charge of 188.10 standing before the courtesy).** Booked in the mobile app with an active membership: 182.457, so 182.46 once rounded. Booked at the call center without a membership: 186.219, so 186.22 once rounded. Booked through an online travel agency: 188.10.
